definitions.explanation: The traditional lunisolar calendar used in Japan before the adoption of the Gregorian calendar in 1873. Still referenced for traditional festivals and seasonal events.

examples.japanese: {旧暦|きゅうれき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{正月|しょうがつ}→正月：01433_shougatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧2⟦{月|がつ}→月：30418_gatsu⟧ごろだ。
examples.english: New Year on the lunar calendar falls around February.

examples.japanese: ⟦{七夕|たなばた}→七夕：05633_tanabata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{旧暦|きゅうれき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧8⟦{月|がつ}→月：30418_gatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧。
examples.english: Tanabata falls in August on the lunar calendar.

examples.japanese: ⟦{沖縄|おきなわ}→沖縄：11009_okinawa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{旧暦|きゅうれき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{基|もと}づいて→基づく：02315_motozuku⟧⟦{行事|ぎょうじ}→行事：00078_gyouji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: In Okinawa, many areas still hold events based on the lunar calendar.

notes:
USAGE:
Japan adopted the Gregorian calendar ({新暦|しんれき}) in 1873 (Meiji 6). The old lunisolar calendar is still called {旧暦|きゅうれき} and remains relevant for traditional festivals, especially in Okinawa and rural areas. Some seasonal events (⟦お{盆|ぼん}→お盆：05587_obon⟧, ⟦{七夕|たなばた}→七夕：05633_tanabata⟧) are celebrated on either the old or new calendar depending on the region.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {旧暦|きゅうれき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{正月|しょうがつ}→正月：01433_shougatsu⟧: New Year by the lunar calendar
- {旧暦|きゅうれき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{基|もと}づく→基づく：02315_motozuku⟧: based on the lunar calendar
- {旧暦|きゅうれき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: in terms of the lunar calendar

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {新暦|しんれき}: new calendar (Gregorian calendar)
- {太陰暦|たいいんれき}: lunar calendar (technical term)
- ⟦{暦|こよみ}→暦：19338_koyomi⟧: calendar (general)
